verdict.rationale: Vapi's voice agents act on their own during calls. Assistant hooks automate actions when call events occur, and tools call your server via webhooks to transfer calls, look up records or book appointments. Existing Make scenarios and GHL workflows can be imported. These automations are tied to live calls, though, not standalone background jobs. missing for 10: scheduled or triggered background runs (cron or outbound campaigns), automations that run without an active call, independent hands-on corroboration.
